title: Beyond Dimensionality: Domain Shift and Catastrophic Forgetting in Single- vs. Multi-Vector Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2603.29519v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent work by Weller et al. introduced the naturalistic benchmark LIMIT and showed that widely used single-vector embedding models suffer substantial degradation in retrieval quality, attributing this primarily to limited embedding dimensionality. In our work, we revisit this explanation and argue that dimensionality alone is unlikely to account for the observed failures; in fact, results of Alon et al. imply that $2k+1$ dimensions suffice for top-$k$ retrieval over a fixed set of queries and documents. Motivated by this, we investigate alternative drivers of poor performance, including tokenization, linguistic structure, and domain shift. Our empirical analysis shows that tokenization artifacts and linguistic similarity yield only modest improvements, whereas domain shift and misalignment between embedding similarity and task-specific relevance are the dominant factors. translated_title: 超越维度：单向量与多向量检索中的领域偏移与灾难性遗忘
translated_abstract: Weller 等人最近的工作引入了自然化基准 LIMIT，并表明广泛使用的单向量嵌入模型在检索质量上出现显著下降，他们将此主要归因于有限的嵌入维度。在我们的工作中，我们重新审视了这一解释，并认为仅凭维度不太可能解释所观察到的失效现象；事实上，Alon 等人的结果意味着 2k+1 维足以在固定的查询和文档集合上进行 top-k 检索。基于此，我们研究了导致性能不佳的其他驱动因素，包括分词、语言结构和领域偏移。我们的实证分析表明，分词伪影和语言相似性仅带来适度的改进，而领域偏移以及嵌入相似性与任务特定相关性之间的错位才是主导因素。虽然微调可以部分缓解这些问题并改善……
tldr: 该研究反驳了嵌入维度是单向量检索模型失效主因的观点，实证表明领域偏移以及嵌入相似性与任务相关性之间的错位才是导致检索质量下降的主导因素。
en_tdlr: This work challenges the claim that limited embedding dimensionality causes single-vector retrieval failures, showing empirically that domain shift and the misalignment between embedding similarity and task-specific relevance are the dominant factors.
